# 8. Analysis: Snow Depth Thresholds

## 8.1 Lambs

```{r}
#| label: thresh-lamb-calc
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Snow threshold variables to test (10 cm to 100 cm increments)
days_vars <- paste0("days_gt_", seq(10, 100, 10))

# Prepare lamb datasets for threshold modeling
d_lamb <- Data_lamb_scaled |>
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex), Yr = factor(Yr)) |>
  select(Survival, Sex, wtd114, pop_den, median_density, Yr, days_count, all_of(days_vars)) |>
  drop_na()

d_lamb_uns <- Data_lambs_uns |>
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex), Yr = factor(Yr)) |>
  select(Survival, Sex, wtd114, pop_den, median_density, Yr, days_count, all_of(days_vars)) |>
  drop_na()

# Fit threshold models across each snow depth cutoff
fit_lamb_days_model <- function(day_var) {
  f <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Survival ~ Sex * (wtd114 + median_density + pop_den) + ", day_var, " + ",
      "Sex:", day_var, " + (1 | Yr)"
    )
  )

  brm(
    formula = bf(f),
    data = d_lamb,
    family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
    chains = 4, iter = 10000, warmup = 4000, cores = 4,
    seed = 123, refresh = 0, backend = "cmdstanr", threads = threading(2)
  )
}

models_lamb_days <- days_vars |>
  purrr::set_names() |>
  purrr::map(fit_lamb_days_model)
```

```{r}
#| label: thresh-lamb-results
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Compare threshold models via LOO-CV
loo_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(models_lamb_days, \(mod, nm) {
  est <- loo(mod)$estimates
  tibble(
    model = nm,
    elpd_loo = est["elpd_loo", "Estimate"],
    elpd_se  = est["elpd_loo", "SE"]
  )
}) |>
  arrange(desc(elpd_loo))

# Diagnostics for best threshold model (90 cm)
pp_check(models_lamb_days$days_gt_90, type = "bars", ndraws = 100) + theme_pubr()
lamb_thresh_powerscale <- powerscale_sensitivity(models_lamb_days$days_gt_90)
p_direction(models_lamb_days$days_gt_90)

# Export summary table to Word
ft_lamb_thresh <- flextable(extract_brms_summary(models_lamb_days$days_gt_90, "Lamb")) |> autofit()
doc <- read_docx()       
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_lamb_thresh)   
print(doc, target = "result_model_lamb_thresh.docx")
```

```{r}
#| label: thresh-lamb-plots
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Plot marginal effect of days >= 90 cm on lamb survival
data_mean_lamb_thresh <- d_lamb_uns |>
  group_by(Sex, days_gt_90) |>
  summarise(
    survival_rate = mean(Survival, na.rm = TRUE), 
    n = n(),                                      
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ce_sex_days90 <- conditional_effects(
  models_lamb_days$days_gt_90,
  effects = "days_gt_90:Sex"
)

plot_sex_days90 <- ce_sex_days90$`days_gt_90:Sex` |>
  mutate(days_gt_90 = days_gt_90 * sd(Data_lambs_uns$days_gt_90) + mean(Data_lambs_uns$days_gt_90))

p_sex_days90 <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = plot_sex_days90, 
    aes(x = days_gt_90, ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__, fill = Sex), 
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_sex_days90, 
    aes(x = days_gt_90, y = estimate__, color = Sex), 
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = data_mean_lamb_thresh, 
    aes(x = days_gt_90, y = survival_rate, color = Sex, size = n), 
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#7a2554", "Male" = "#dd9a0a")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#7a2554", "Male" = "#dd9a0a")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), name = "Sample size (N)") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Days ≥ 90 cm", 
    y = "Survival probability", 
    color = "Sex", 
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_pubr()

p_sex_days90
```

## 8.2 Females

```{r}
#| label: thresh-fem-calc
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Prepare female datasets for threshold modeling
d_fem <- Data_female_scaled |>
  mutate(Yr = factor(Yr)) |>
  select(Survival, Age, wtd114, pop_den, median_density, Yr, all_of(days_vars)) |>
  drop_na()

d_fem_uns <- Data_females_uns |>
  mutate(Yr = factor(Yr)) |>
  select(Survival, Age, wtd114, pop_den, median_density, Yr, all_of(days_vars)) |>
  drop_na()

# Fit threshold models across each snow depth cutoff
fit_female_days_model <- function(day_var) {
  f <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Survival ~ ns(Age, 3) + wtd114 + pop_den + median_density + ", day_var, " + ",
      "(1 | Yr)"
    )
  )

  brm(
    formula = bf(f),
    data = d_fem,
    family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
    chains = 4, iter = 10000, warmup = 4000, cores = 4,
    seed = 123, refresh = 0,
    backend = "cmdstanr", threads = threading(2)
  )
}

models_female_days <- days_vars |>
  purrr::set_names() |>
  purrr::map(fit_female_days_model)
```

